segments.zh: 但显然随着时间的推移它可能会改变，你可以得到更多的钱。

segments.en: So this means that you will start making this much money, but it's possible that in the future you will make more.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着你会开始赚这么多钱，但未来你可能会赚更多的钱。

segments.en: This is the starting salary.
segments.zh: 这是起薪。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And well, of course, as we said, it's $150,000, Hong Kong dollars, per annum.
segments.zh: 当然，正如我们说的，是每年 150,000 港元。

segments.zh: 因此，现在我们指定您每年获得这笔钱的频率。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: So this is the remuneration package she's getting.

segments.en: OK.

segments.en: So many of us had allowances when we were children.
segments.zh: 小时候，我们中的许多人都有津贴。

segments.en: This means the money that your parents gave you each week, $5 or $10.
segments.zh: 这意味着您的父母每周给您的钱，5 美元或 10 美元。

segments.en: Well a housing allowance is a little bit different.
segments.zh: 好吧，住房津贴有点不同。

segments.en: It means the money that your company gives you per month or per year to pay for your apartment or your house.
segments.zh: 这意味着您的公司每月或每年为您支付公寓或房屋的费用。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.zh: 所以很明显，公司是这么说的，看，我们会给你一定数量的钱来支付你的房子。

segments.en: You don't have to really pay for your house.
segments.zh: 你不必真正为你的房子买单。

segments.en: We'll pay for it.
segments.zh: 我们会付钱的。

segments.en: So basically it's a benefit.
segments.zh: 所以基本上这是一个好处。

segments.en: It's a part of this remuneration package.
segments.zh: 这是这个薪酬方案的一部分。

segments.en: You get a salary and you get money for your house.
segments.zh: 你得到了薪水，你得到了你的房子的钱。

segments.en: It's a pretty nice deal.
segments.zh: 这是一个相当不错的交易。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And well also she's getting health insurance and she is also being offered a company staff bonus scheme.
segments.zh: 好吧，她还获得了健康保险，她还获得了公司员工奖金计划。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bonus scheme.

segments.en: A bonus is something extra.
segments.zh: 奖金是额外的东西。

segments.en: It's on top of what you normally get.
segments.zh: 它在你通常得到的东西之上。

segments.en: But a bonus scheme indicates that the bonus changes according to how well you do.
segments.zh: 但是奖金计划表明奖金会根据您的表现而变化。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So obviously he's specifying that the bonus scheme is linked to readership numbers.
segments.zh: 很明显，他指定奖金计划与读者人数相关联。

segments.zh: 因此，假设 Marco 出售报纸。

segments.en: Marco, you sell on a good week a hundred newspapers.
segments.zh: 马可，行情好的一周你能卖出一百份报纸。

segments.en: If you sell a hundred fifty, you get a bonus of ten dollars.
segments.zh: 如果你卖一百五十，你会得到十美元的奖金。

segments.en: But if you sell two hundred newspapers, you get a bonus of fifty dollars.
segments.zh: 但如果你卖了两百份报纸，你会得到五十美元的奖金。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: The numbers change.

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So all of this that we've just talked about, to be clear, is our remuneration package.
segments.zh: 因此，我们刚刚谈到的所有这些都是我们的薪酬方案。

segments.en: We're talking about a salary.
segments.zh: 我们说的是薪水。

segments.zh: 我们谈论的是住房津贴、健康保险，甚至是奖金计划。

segments.en: So a package can include these things and much, much more.
segments.zh: 所以 package 可以包含这些东西，甚至多得多。

segments.en: CEOs get bigger remuneration packages.
segments.zh: 首席执行官获得更大的薪酬方案。

segments.en: They do.
segments.zh: 他们会。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a lot of great stuff there talking about salaries and a little bit of negotiating it.
segments.zh: 所以那里有很多关于薪资以及一点谈判技巧的好内容。

segments.en: OK.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, I'm sure you have a number of questions to ask me regarding the position.
segments.zh: 好吧，我相信你有很多问题要问我关于这个职位的问题。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Well, feel free to ask me anything and I'll try to fill in the details.

segments.en: That's quite an important point, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这很重要，不是吗？

segments.en: As a junior sub editor, we offer a starting salary of one hundred and fifty thousand Hong Kong dollars per annum.
segments.zh: 作为初级副编辑，我们提供每年十五万港元的起薪。

segments.en: This doesn't include a generous housing allowance also.
segments.zh: 这还不包括另外提供的优厚住房津贴。

segments.en: I understand.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: And are there other bonuses included?
segments.zh: 是否包括其他奖金？

segments.en: Well, apart from full health insurance, we do offer a company staff bonus scheme linked to readership numbers.

segments.en: But we could go through all the details of that at a later date.

segments.en: The opportunity to work in Hong Kong with your company is the most important thing for me.

segments.en: So at the beginning of the dialogue, Rebecca is talking to Mr. Parsons about the job and she says, you know, I don't really have that many questions, but when I talked to Miss Childs about the job over the phone, there were some things she wanted to clarify.
segments.zh: 所以在对话开始时，丽贝卡正在和帕森斯先生谈论这份工作，她说，你知道，我真的没有那么多问题，但是当我通过电话与柴尔兹小姐谈论这份工作时，她想澄清一些事情。

segments.en: So how did she talk to her?
segments.zh: 那么她是如何与她交谈的呢？

segments.en: She talked to her over the phone.
segments.zh: 她通过电话与她交谈。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is a really good phrase to specify that you received information or you did business talking on the phone, not in person.
segments.zh: 所以这是个很好用的短语，用来表示你是通过电话获取信息或谈事情，而不是面对面。

segments.en: OK, so this is a bit strange because we use the preposition over.
segments.zh: 好的，这有点奇怪，因为我们用的是介词 over。

segments.en: You could also say I'm on the phone.
segments.zh: 你也可以说我在打电话。

segments.en: That means I'm talking on the phone.
segments.zh: 这意味着我在打电话。

segments.en: But over the phone means by phone.
segments.zh: 但通过电话意味着通过电话。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Not by mail or email or in person.
segments.zh: 不是通过邮件或电子邮件或亲自。

segments.en: But we communicate, we talk over the phone by phone.
segments.zh: 但我们交流、聊天用的是 over the phone，也就是通过电话。

segments.en: So sometimes, for example, people will see a TV commercial with a nice item or device that they want to buy and they will purchase this object, maybe a DVD player over the phone.
segments.zh: 所以有时候，比如人们看到一则电视广告，里面有他们想买的好东西或设备，就会买下这件东西，比如通过电话订购一台 DVD 播放机。

segments.en: They will call up this number and order it.
segments.zh: 他们会拨打这个号码并订购它。

segments.en: Or you can say, you know, I'm really sorry, Marco, but I don't feel comfortable talking about my banking details over the phone.
segments.zh: 或者你可以说，你知道，我真的很抱歉，Marco，但我不太愿意在电话里谈我的银行信息。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: OK, so that means on the phone.
segments.zh: 好的，这意味着在电话上。

segments.en: So then Mr. Parsons said, feel free to ask me anything.

segments.en: OK, feel free to ask me anything about the job.
segments.zh: 好的，请随时向我询问有关这项工作的任何信息。

segments.en: OK, this is a phrase that I use all the time, and I think it's really important when you're in a business context or a work context to say, listen, if you have any questions, feel free to ask.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是我一直使用的短语，我认为当您在商业环境或工作环境中说，听着，如果您有任何问题，请随时提问，这一点非常重要。

segments.en: It means don't hesitate.
segments.zh: 这意味着不要犹豫。

segments.en: Don't be nervous.
segments.zh: 不要紧张。

segments.en: If you have a question, just ask it.
segments.zh: 如果您有问题，请问。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So feel free to ask.
segments.zh: 所以随意问。

segments.en: Don't worry about it.
segments.zh: 别担心。

segments.en: Just ask me.
segments.zh: 就问我。

segments.en: It's a very good phrase to give someone or to make someone feel more comfortable.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常好的短语，可以给某人或让某人感觉更舒服。

segments.en: Exactly, exactly.
segments.zh: 确切地说。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And he said that I'll try to fill in the details.
segments.zh: 他说我会尽量填写细节。

segments.en: OK, so this is an interesting phrase because fill in, you know, on a form, for example, means put your name in a box or fill in some numbers.
segments.zh: 好的，所以这是一个有趣的短语，因为您知道，例如，在表单上填写您的名字或填写一些数字。

segments.en: But here the details, we think maybe maybe I don't know what the details are.
segments.zh: 但这里的细节，我们认为也许我不知道细节是什么。

segments.en: So to fill them in means to fill in gaps or some blanks.
segments.zh: 所以填写它们意味着填补空白或一些空白。

segments.en: So like, I don't know all the details.
segments.zh: 就像，我不知道所有的细节。

segments.en: Please tell me the information so that I will know them.
segments.zh: 请把信息告诉我，这样我就知道了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So what he's basically saying is I know that you have an idea or a general overview of how things are.
segments.zh: 所以他基本上说的是我知道你对事情的情况有一个想法或一般概述。

segments.en: But if you ask me, I can tell you more specific things that fill in the details.
segments.zh: 但如果你问我，我可以告诉你更具体的内容，填写细节。

segments.en: Or, for example, we're going to a party on Saturday night, but I don't know where the party is yet.
segments.zh: 或者，例如，我们将在周六晚上参加一个派对，但我还不知道派对在哪里。

segments.en: How about on Friday?
segments.zh: 星期五怎么样？

segments.en: I call you to fill you in on the details.
segments.zh: 我会打电话把细节告诉你。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: OK, so those are the phrases that we've prepared for you today.
segments.zh: 好的，这些是我们今天为您准备的短语。

segments.en: I think we've taken a look at a lot of great vocab.
segments.zh: 我想我们已经看了很多很棒的词汇。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to the dialogue one last time and we'll be back to talk to you a little bit more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再最后听一遍对话，回来后再多聊一会儿。

segments.en: OK, well I'm sure you have a number of questions to ask me regarding the position.
segments.zh: 好的，我相信你有很多问题要问我关于这个职位的问题。

segments.en: Yes, well, Miss Charles did give me an overview of the position over the phone.
segments.zh: 是的，嗯，Charles 小姐确实在电话里向我概述过这个职位。

segments.en: But there were some details I'd like to clarify.
segments.zh: 但有一些细节我想澄清一下。

segments.en: Well feel free to ask me anything and I'll try to fill in the details.
segments.zh: 好吧，尽管问我任何问题，我会尽量把细节补充清楚。

segments.en: Could I first ask about the remuneration package?
segments.zh: 我能先了解一下整体薪酬待遇吗？

segments.en: Yes, of course.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。

segments.en: That's quite an important point, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这很重要，不是吗？

segments.en: As a junior sub-editor, we offer a starting salary of one hundred and fifty thousand Hong Kong dollars per annum.
segments.zh: 作为初级副编辑，我们提供每年十五万港元的起薪。

segments.en: This doesn't include a generous housing allowance also.
segments.zh: 这还不包括另外提供的优厚住房津贴。

segments.en: I understand.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: And are there other bonuses included?
segments.zh: 是否包括其他奖金？

segments.en: Well apart from full health insurance, we do offer a company staff bonus scheme linked to readership numbers.
segments.zh: 除了完整的健康保险外，我们还提供与读者人数相关的公司员工奖金计划。

segments.en: But we could go through all the details of that at a later date.
segments.zh: 但我们可以在以后了解所有细节。

segments.en: Well Mr. Parsons, I am flexible when it comes to salary.
segments.zh: 好吧，帕森斯先生，我在薪水方面很灵活。

segments.en: The opportunity to work in Hong Kong with your company is the most important thing for me.
segments.zh: 与贵公司一起在香港工作的机会对我来说是最重要的。

segments.en: Excellent.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Well, what other questions do you have, Rebecca?
segments.zh: 好吧，丽贝卡，你还有什么其他问题？

segments.en: Alright so talking about salaries and remuneration packages.
segments.zh: 好吧，谈谈薪水和薪酬方案。

segments.en: Now is this a common word to talk about remuneration?
segments.zh: 现在这是谈论薪酬的常用词吗？

segments.en: Yes it is.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: It basically means the way that you are paid for the work that you do.
segments.zh: 这基本上意味着您为您所做的工作获得报酬的方式。

segments.en: So remuneration, it sounds like a big long word.
segments.zh: 所以报酬，听起来像是一个很大的长词。

segments.en: But in America I think we also just talk about salary or compensation.
segments.zh: 但在美国，我认为我们也只是谈论薪水或薪酬。

segments.en: Compensation packages.
segments.zh: 薪酬方案（compensation package）。

segments.en: Ok, so now when we talk about remuneration, we don't necessarily always talk about money like in this case, right?
segments.zh: 好的，现在当我们谈论薪酬时，我们不一定总是像这种情况下那样谈论金钱，对吧？

segments.en: We can receive other benefits.
segments.zh: 我们可以获得其他福利。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so a lot of times people think of the important parts of remuneration not just to be the salary but also to be the benefits.
segments.zh: 所以很多时候人们认为薪酬的重要部分不仅是薪水，而且是福利。

segments.en: And so benefits are not the money, they are the other stuff.
segments.zh: 所以福利不是钱，它们是其他东西。

segments.en: They're health care.
segments.zh: 它们是医疗保健。

segments.en: We said earlier a housing allowance, even bonuses and things like that or education for your children.
segments.zh: 我们之前说过住房津贴，甚至奖金和类似的东西，或者为您的孩子提供教育。

segments.en: These are extras and these are a part of the package.
segments.zh: 这些是额外福利，是 package 的一部分。

segments.en: Now what would you prefer?
segments.zh: 现在你更喜欢什么？

segments.en: To have a good remuneration package like these other additional benefits with a low salary or would you prefer to have a high salary with not many of these benefits?
segments.zh: 是愿意有一份像这样福利很好、但薪水较低的薪酬方案，还是更愿意拿高薪、但福利不多？

segments.en: Well I think that it's nice to get the benefits and a lower salary because often times at a company, like a big company, the company can get really good rates on health care.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为获得福利和更低的薪水是件好事，因为通常在公司，就像一家大公司一样，公司可以获得非常好的医疗保健费率。

segments.en: So if I have to pay for my health care with my big salary, maybe it will cost me more money.
segments.zh: 因此，如果我必须用我的高薪来支付我的医疗保健费用，也许会花费我更多的钱。

segments.en: But if my company pays with the company rate, that means the amount that they pay, then maybe they can help me pay for these things much cheaper.
segments.zh: 但是，如果我的公司以公司费率支付，这意味着他们支付的金额，那么也许他们可以帮助我更便宜地支付这些费用。

segments.en: And so in the end I make more money.
segments.zh: 所以最后我赚了更多的钱。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Actually I've heard some companies that offer great remuneration packages like if you have children as you said they will pay for their education.
segments.zh: 实际上，我听说过一些公司提供优惠的薪酬方案，例如如果您有孩子，他们会支付他们的教育费用。

segments.en: But many times they would even pay for their child care, like maybe a nanny.
segments.zh: 但很多时候，他们甚至会支付他们的托儿费用，就像一个保姆一样。

segments.en: Some of them, some of the managers would receive maybe a fuel bonus.
segments.zh: 其中一些，一些经理可能会获得燃料奖励。

segments.en: So they would get, I don't know, $200 extra a month for fuel for their car if they drive to work.
segments.zh: 所以，我不知道，如果他们开车上班，他们每月会额外获得 200 美元的燃料用于他们的汽车。

segments.en: So I think companies can get a little bit creative and it's not that much that they're actually spending but you take it as to being a really good benefit.
segments.zh: 所以我觉得公司可以发挥一点创意，其实他们花的钱并不多，但你却会把它当成一项很好的福利。

segments.en: Well that's right and it makes you more I think happy to work for that company because you feel like they're taking care of you.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是对的，它让你更喜欢为那家公司工作，因为你觉得他们正在照顾你。

segments.en: Not just they're giving you money, they're actually taking care of you and your family.
segments.zh: 他们不仅给你钱，他们实际上是在照顾你和你的家人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're actually a little bit curious to know how remuneration packages work in your company or maybe in your country.
segments.zh: 因此，我们实际上有点好奇，了解您的公司或您所在的国家/地区的薪酬方案如何运作。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So please let us know.
segments.zh: 所以请告诉我们。

segments.en: You obviously don't have to tell us how much money you earn but if you want to tell us how these things work, where you come from, our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 您显然不必告诉我们您赚了多少钱，但如果您想告诉我们这些事情是如何运作的，您来自哪里，我们的网站是 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: We'll see you there.
segments.zh: 到时候见。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: All right so thank you very much.
segments.zh: 好的，非常感谢。
